Appointment Setter - Trivium

Trivium

Países permitidosMéxico, LATAM
Modalidad100% Remote (Work from anywhere)
Idioma requeridoInglés (B2+)
Experiencia1–3 years as Appointment Setter, SDR, or similar role
SalarioCompetitive salary + benefits
HorarioFull-time (9:00 AM EST - 6:00 PM EST)
Tipo de contrataciónFull-time
Fecha de publicación2026-11-28 (Límite: 2026-12-28)

Descripción del puesto

Join Trivium's remote Sales Team to reach out to potential clients via cold calls, LinkedIn, and email, qualifying leads and scheduling appointments for Sales Closers.

Funciones principales

  • Conduct outbound calls, LinkedIn outreach, and email follow-ups to connect with prospects.
  • Find, qualify, and engage leads based on Trivium's ideal client criteria.
  • Schedule and confirm sales calls or free audits for Sales Closers.
  • Maintain accurate daily CRM records and meet weekly/monthly outreach KPIs.

Requisitos

  • 1–3 years of experience as an Appointment Setter, SDR, or similar (eCommerce/agency preferred).
  • Comfortable making 100–200 cold calls a day.
  • Excellent written and spoken English (B2+ minimum).
  • Experience with CRMs like HubSpot, GoHighLevel, or similar.

Beneficios

  • 100% remote work from anywhere.
  • Competitive salary + benefits.
  • 25 PTO days + 9 paid holidays and ongoing training.
